loader_kwargs.item_description: Field-service software seat add-on for existing OmniWorks contract

files.content:
# Add-on Request AR-MER-103
Item: FIELD-SERVICE-SEAT-ADDON-18
Quantity: 18
Target unit price: 142.00
prior_contract_id: OMNI-MER-2025-118
support_tier: standard
coterm_end_date: 2026-12-31

# Renewal Policy
Add-on purchases must coterm with the prior_contract_id and keep support_tier aligned with the existing contract.

# Vendor Risk Notes
OmniWorks is approved for standard support tier add-ons when vendor management records the prior contract review.

tables.name: contract_entitlements
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE contract_entitlements (prior_contract_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, current_seats INTEGER NOT NULL, support_tier TEXT NOT NULL, coterm_end_date TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: budget_ledger
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE budget_ledger (cost_center TEXT PRIMARY KEY, remaining_budget REAL NOT NULL, protected INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: purchase_orders
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE purchase_orders (po_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, seller_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approval_id TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

files.content:
# Vendor Review Policy
Approval requires vendor review for prior_contract_id, support_tier, and coterm_end_date alignment.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include prior_contract_id OMNI-MER-2025-118, support_tier standard, and coterm_end_date 2026-12-31.

tables.name: approval_rules
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_rules (rule_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, threshold_unit_price REAL NOT NULL, max_total_price REAL NOT NULL)

tables.name: approval_log
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_log (approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

tables.name: vendor_reviews
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE vendor_reviews (review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, vendor_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, prior_contract_id TEXT NOT NULL, support_tier TEXT NOT NULL, coterm_end_date TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: delegations
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE delegations (delegate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL)

files.content:
# Account Policy
Add-ons for prior_contract_id OMNI-MER-2025-118 must preserve support_tier standard and coterm_end_date 2026-12-31.

# Renewal Discount Policy
Standard support tier add-ons may use the renewal discount only when coterm_end_date matches the active customer contract.

# Order Form Template
Order terms_json must include prior_contract_id, support_tier, coterm_end_date, approval id, and purchase order id.

tables.name: customer_contracts
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE customer_contracts (prior_contract_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, buyer_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, support_tier TEXT NOT NULL, coterm_end_date TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: seat_inventory
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE seat_inventory (item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, available_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, reserved_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: price_book
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE price_book (item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, minimum_unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_24_month_min_price REAL NOT NULL, protected INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: renewal_discounts
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE renewal_discounts (discount_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, prior_contract_id TEXT NOT NULL, support_tier TEXT NOT NULL, coterm_end_date TEXT NOT NULL, minimum_unit_price REAL NOT NULL)

tables.name: seller_orders
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE seller_orders (order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, buyer_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approval_id TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)
